narrativeProgression.description: Peng Zhao begins by stating that automation has significantly impacted financial markets.
He provides an example of how bid-ask spreads have decreased drastically due to automation, benefiting investors.
He illustrates how technology has made trading more accessible and affordable for the average person.
He emphasizes that this technological advancement has brought positive changes to the market.
He concludes by expressing optimism about the future potential of technology in finance and calls for collective action.
